snippet.title: The Making of Invariant | Part 1: Introduction & Origins | Sci-Fi FPS
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4692380/Invariant/?beta=0
Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/P7dUSJzgDq

After a catastrophic incident cuts an isolated Antarctic research facility off from the outside world, a desperate fight for survival begins. As systems fail, communications break down and hostile creatures roam the facility, pieces of a larger mystery begin to emerge from the chaos left behind.

Invariant is an atmospheric, story-driven sci-fi FPS set in the 1990s, combining exploration, environmental puzzles and intense combat in the depths of Antarctica.
